|errata_history=This is the only version of a '''retired''' Virtual Modern card. '''Retired:''' the PC replaced this card with the March 2021 errata, released with [[Virtual Set 14]] on 18 March 2021: the new card [[I Don't Like Sand]] (same game text except “peek at top two cards” and “a card here”, new title, art and lore, printed “E”) was published that day ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a3ec4056a5d32467edd4bc060cc72bd12e95cead holotable commit a3ec405]) and from 19 March 2021 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/2a5e530f35e8b889d4dc48fc401fd1ddf1710277 card-json commit 2a5e530], “Set 14, March 2021 Errata”) the card data gives it GEMP slot <code>200_39</code>, which had held “Evacuation Control (V)” since the card data began ([https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/3e5a4c7d843d06df8b00a88f8904d93f74702c23 card-json commit 3e5a4c7]). Holotable's card list dropped Evacuation Control (V) on 26 March 2021 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/c791ce940cac95ce7e7c91c69360b7a60d552cdf holotable commit c791ce9]); its image file was never deleted. Bill ruled (12 November 2026, on [[Jabba's Prize (V)]] and [[The Mythrol / •The Mythrol]]) that a card whose GEMP slot was reused for another card is not part of the new card's family, so this card keeps its own version history here and is not listed with [[I Don't Like Sand]]. The image is the Players Committee card image of this version ([[:File:V0-L-evacuationcontrol-2018-07-08.gif]]). Each version below is a published PC card image; dates are the upload dates in the PC's image repository. Card images that changed in any visible way are separate versions (Bill, 12 Nov 2026).
* '''Original''' (this page): PC card image uploaded by 8 July 2018<ref name="img-V0-L-evacuationcontrol022435b">Players Committee card image <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/evacuationcontrol.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable repository, version of [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 commit 022435b] (by 8 July 2018). Status of the file today: the file is still in the repository but no card uses it since 26 March 2021.</ref> (earliest copy found: the first commit of the repository; the card was printed earlier and no earlier image of it was found). Document: no errata mark; bottom margin “Evacuation Control”. Text: “Deploy on table; shuffle your Reserve Deck, peek at top three cards, and stack them face-up here. During battle, may take a stacked card into hand to prevent all battle destiny draws from being modified or canceled (each player may draw no more than one battle destiny). (Immune to Alter.)”
* '''Retired''' (18 March 2021): the PC replaced this card with the March 2021 errata, released with [[Virtual Set 14]] on 18 March 2021: the new card [[I Don't Like Sand]] (same game text except “peek at top two cards” and “a card here”, new title, art and lore, printed “E”) was published that day ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/a3ec4056a5d32467edd4bc060cc72bd12e95cead holotable commit a3ec405]) and from 19 March 2021 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/2a5e530f35e8b889d4dc48fc401fd1ddf1710277 card-json commit 2a5e530], “Set 14, March 2021 Errata”) the card data gives it GEMP slot <code>200_39</code>, which had held “Evacuation Control (V)” since the card data began ([https://github.com/swccgpc/swccg-card-json/commit/3e5a4c7d843d06df8b00a88f8904d93f74702c23 card-json commit 3e5a4c7]). Holotable's card list dropped Evacuation Control (V) on 26 March 2021 ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/c791ce940cac95ce7e7c91c69360b7a60d552cdf holotable commit c791ce9]); its image file was never deleted.
